target.name: macos-apfs-sensitive
notes: Owned case-sensitive APFS sparse images; shared Mac, warm caches. Compare versions within this target, not across Linux hardware.

config.environment: Shared Apple M1 Ultra, macOS 26.5 build 25F71; internal APFS SSD, owned sparse filesystem images, warm caches. Published v0.4 ARM baseline vs clean-main candidate built with Rust 1.100.0. No competing controlled builds/benchmarks or package updates. Synthetic checkout profiles, not real-repository or cross-hardware Linux comparisons.

notes: Shared-host warm-cache loopback measurements, not bare-device or universal speed claims.
No retries. Complete paired groups only. Rust owns timing, allocation, full byte verification and private-write probes.
Binary source commits are operator declarations; SHA-256 identifies the measured bytes.
